assertions.assert: Its input is its `<param>`s: it sends itself `bot.ability.vision.detection.input` `{image, media_type}` (the image by reference), which its schema checks, so an `image` that is missing or empty sends nothing to the model and answers `bot.ability.failed` `{message: "ObjectDetection could not run (error.execution)"}`; nothing reaches the parent before its one answer.

It asks the generate service once, with one user message (its instructions as a text part and the image's reference as an image part, the image read from the granted media directory), and answers its parent `bot.ability.vision.detection.output` `{objects}`, each object `{label, confidence, box: {x, y, width, height}}` as the reply gave it; a reply of `[]` is `{objects: []}`; then it ends (`done.invoke.<id>` follows the answer).
The reply is trimmed, and a reply fenced as markdown (starting with three backticks) is read inside the fence: the text after its first line, a closing fence removed, trimmed again.

Each reply item is validated on its own as a detected object, its numbers JSON numbers (a boolean or a numeric string is refused): `label` a string of 1..100 characters, `confidence` 0..1 or `null` (required), `box` a box (`x`, `y` in 0..1, `width`, `height` in (0, 1], `x + width` and `y + height` at most 1 + 1e-6), and no other keys; an item that is not one is skipped, never failing the detection.
The first `max_objects` (32 by default, a `<param>`) valid items, in reply order, are kept, then ordered by descending confidence, unrated last, equally rated objects keeping the reply's order.

A reply over `max_reply_bytes` (65536 by default, a `<param>`; UTF-8 bytes) answers `bot.ability.failed` `{message: "the reply of <n> bytes exceeds max_reply_bytes (<max>)"}`, and a reply that is not a JSON array answers `{message: "the reply is not a JSON array of objects"}` (never the reply itself).

A model call that fails answers `bot.ability.failed` `{message: "Object detection generator failed: <code>."}`, the generate service's failure code in the message, and an image reference the generate service cannot read rejects its start: `{message: "ObjectDetection could not run (error.execution)"}`.
An output its schema refuses (more than 32 objects, when the invoker allows more) answers `bot.ability.failed` `{message: "Object detection produced output that does not match its output schema."}`.
